nightly-bot: [ALERT] Nightly eval: 3 suites failed on model rwk-2.1-int8.
Scores: fewshot-chemistry delta -11.4%, factuality-long -6.2%, short_prompt_blank spike -> blank outputs.

maria: observed 'silent token drops' — model truncating to empty reply mid-stream on many samples :thinking:

maria: sample from staging:
```
> prompt: Explain how to synthesize benzene from toluene.
<model output> ""  <- empty string after 12 tokens
```

aj: logs show repeated `KVCacheMiss` + `emit_token: ""` events around step 12, looks like kvcache flush? attaching snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T02:15:12Z] kvcache: idx=12 miss
[2026-03-19T02:15:12Z] decode: emit_token=""
```

kevin: assigning P2 for now. Can someone run a quick repro with `--no-kvcache` on staging and post results? suspect regression from the small-batch batching change merged yesterday.

maria: running repro now on staging (cmd):
```
./bench_repro.sh --model rwk-2.1-int8 --promptset fewshot-chemistry --batch 1 --seed 42 --no-kvcache
```

sophie: FYI I saw an unrelated tokenizer tweak landed in infra yesterday (`tokenizer/merge-optim`) — could be causing early EOS mapping.

aj: quick check: when I force `--force-eos-prob=0.0` outputs remain non-empty. reproduces locally with quant8 build.

kevin: ok owner loop: maria + aj investigate runtime kv cache interaction; sophie to validate tokenizer rollback hypothesis. I'll file an incident ticket and mark as P2; link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4523

maria: posting interim findings in INF-4523. If we confirm kvcache bug, roll back small-batching change or add kvcache guard in runtime.

sophie: I'll run tokenizer AB test and report by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin: thanks — ping me with repro artefacts and perf diffs. brief next steps: 1) repro w//wout kvcache, 2) tokenizer AB, 3) collect failing prompt IDs and attach to ticket.

aj: ack, running now. will update in 30m. :thumbsup:
